record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.original_question: Let X be a reducible, reduced, connected projective curve. Under what assumptions on X, the rank, the polarization, and related numerical data does Butler's semistability question for the kernel bundle M_{E,V} admit a positive answer in the reducible-curve setting?

evidence.quote: Question 14. What assumptions in the case of a reducible curve imply a positive answer to Butler’s question?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a reducible, reduced, connected projective curve over an algebraically closed field, equipped with an ample polarization. Let $E$ be a vector bundle on $X$ generated by a linear subspace $V \subseteq H^0(X,E)$, and define the kernel bundle $M_{E,V}$ by the short exact sequence
$$0 \longrightarrow M_{E,V} \longrightarrow V \otimes \mathcal{O}_X \xrightarrow{\;\mathrm{ev}\;} E \longrightarrow 0,$$
where $\mathrm{ev}$ is the evaluation map. Butler's question asks whether, when $E$ is (semi)stable with respect to the chosen polarization, the kernel bundle $M_{E,V}$ is also (semi)stable.

Determine sufficient assumptions on the curve $X$ (its components, dual graph, and arithmetic genera), on the rank and degree of $E$, on the polarization (e.g.\ a system of weights on the irreducible components), and on the subspace $V \subseteq H^0(X,E)$, that imply $M_{E,V}$ is semistable. In particular, identify a set of numerical and geometric hypotheses under which Butler's question admits a positive answer in the reducible-curve setting.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results exist: kernel bundles on nodal curves with two smooth components, on chain-like and comb-like curves have been studied, with sufficient conditions for w-semistability of $M_{E,V}$ established when $V\subseteq H^0(E)$ or $E$ is a line bundle. Notably, $M_{E,H^0(E)}$ is generally not w-semistable on reducible curves, contrary to the smooth case. A complete characterization in full generality remains open.

status_evidence.title: On kernel bundles over reducible curves with a node
status_evidence.snippet: Studies stability of kernel bundles on nodal reducible curves with two smooth components.
status_evidence.claim: Sufficient conditions for w-semistability of kernel bundles on certain reducible nodal curves are obtained.

status_evidence.title: On the stability of kernel bundles over chain-like curves
status_evidence.snippet: Extends kernel bundle stability results to chain-like reducible curves.
status_evidence.claim: Partial positive answers to Butler-type stability are given for chain-like curves.

status_evidence.title: Exploring the interplay of semistable vector bundles and their restrictions on reducible curves
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) study of semistable vector bundles on reducible curves.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to extend partial results, indicating the general question remains open.
